description: Game Card Totals & Layout Update - Add Totals column to game cards, remove All Markets toggle, fix bet slip UX issues, correct balance display logic, and standardize card backgrounds. IMPORTANT: Maintain the existing dark sports-betting theme styling (Theme.swift) - do NOT revert to default iOS styling.

userStories.title: Remove All Markets Toggle Button
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the All Markets expand button from game cards so the card is cleaner and additional markets are accessed via the detail view.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove expandButton view builder from GameCardView.swift
Remove isExpanded state variable
Remove expandedMarketsSection view builder
Remove the conditional rendering of expandedMarketsSection in the body
Card now shows only the main betting grid (will have Spread, ML, Total after US-004)
Tapping the card still navigates to MarketSelectionView for full market access
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Modify existing GameCardView.swift - just remove expand functionality, don't add Total column yet

userStories.title: Create TotalButton Component and Helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a TotalButton component styled like SpreadButton with line value as main text and odds as secondary.
acceptanceCriteria: Create formatTotalValue function that extracts line from 'Over 220.5' -> 'o220.5' or 'Under 220.5' -> 'u220.5'
Create TotalButton struct in GameCardView.swift modeled after SpreadButton
Button takes totalValue (e.g., 'o220.5'), odds (Int), isSelected (Bool), and action closure
Main text shows totalValue (font size 14, black weight)
Secondary text shows formatted odds below (font size 10, semibold)
Use same selected/unselected styling as SpreadButton (gradients, borders, animations)
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Create component first before integrating - model after SpreadButton structure

userStories.title: Reduce Button Sizes for Three-Column Layout
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to adjust button and text sizes so three columns fit comfortably on screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Reduce oddsButtonSize from 72 to 60 in GameCardView
In SpreadButton: reduce main text from 16 to 14, secondary text from 11 to 10
In MLButton: reduce text from 16 to 14
In TotalButton (from US-002): use 14 for main, 10 for secondary
Reduce team name font size from 15 to 14 in teamOddsRow
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Size adjustments to make room for third column

userStories.title: Add Total Column to Game Card
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see and tap Over/Under totals directly on the game card alongside Spread and ML.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'TOTAL' header in teamsWithOddsSection after ML column (same styling as SPREAD/ML headers)
TOTAL header only shows if totalMarket is available
Modify teamOddsRow to accept totalMarket parameter
Away team row (top) shows Over button using TotalButton
Home team row (bottom) shows Under button using TotalButton
TotalButton receives correct line value from formatTotalValue (sideA for Over, sideB for Under)
Tapping Over/Under adds selection to bet slip via onSelectOdds callback
Selection state reflects correctly (highlighted when in bet slip)
Column order is: Team Name | SPREAD | ML | TOTAL
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: This integrates the TotalButton from US-002 into the game card layout

userStories.title: Fix Bet Slip Segmented Control Tap Area
userStories.description: As a player, I want to tap anywhere on the Singles/Parlay segment to switch modes, not just the text.
acceptanceCriteria: Locate the Singles/Parlay segmented control (likely in BetSlipSheet.swift or BetConfirmationSheet.swift)
Add .contentShape(Rectangle()) to the segment buttons to expand tap area
Ensure entire segment button area is tappable, not just the text label
Both Singles and Parlay segments respond to taps on full button area
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: UX fix for segmented control - may need to examine multiple bet slip related files

userStories.title: Remove Redundant Review Screen from Bet Submission
userStories.description: As a player, I want to submit my bet directly after entering my stake without an extra review step.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the review/confirmation step in bet submission flow (likely BetConfirmationSheet.swift)
Remove or bypass the intermediate review screen state
User enters stake and taps submit to place bet immediately
Confirmation feedback (success toast/alert) still shows after successful submission
Error handling still works for failed submissions
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Streamline bet submission - check BetConfirmationSheet for step/state management

userStories.title: Fix Player Balance Display Logic
userStories.description: As a player, I want the balance display to show positive when I'm in good standing and negative when I owe money.
acceptanceCriteria: Review balance calculation in BalanceService.swift
Positive balance = player is in credit (good standing, bookie owes player)
Negative balance = player owes money to the bookie (debt)
Update any inverted logic in balance calculations or display
Update AppHeaderView.swift balance color logic if needed: green for positive (credit), red for negative (debt)
Verify AccountView.swift shows balance correctly
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Check BalanceService, AppHeaderView, AccountView for balance semantics

userStories.title: Standardize Card Background Colors
userStories.description: As a user, I want consistent card background styling across the app using the Account page card color.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the card background color used on Player AccountView (should be Theme.cardBackground)
Update Settings tab (PlayerSettingsView or PlayerSettingsContent) to use Theme.cardBackground for section backgrounds
Update Bookie dashboard cards (BookieDashboardView or similar) to use Theme.cardBackground
All card/section backgrounds should use consistent Theme.cardBackground color
Project builds and runs in Simulator
userStories.notes: Ensure visual consistency - may need to check multiple view files
